kit.title: Aura vs Skylight vs Nixplay: which photo frame to give
kit.hook: Picture this: Grandma's new photo frame stays black for a month.

scenes.narration: Picture this: you give Grandma a photo frame. A month later it is still a black screen, and she dusts it.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a grandparent politely nodding at a blank frame

scenes.narration: Grandma will not load the photo frame. The family will. So pick by who sends.
Phone-first family? Aura. Photos go in from its app, with no subscription and unlimited photos.
Cousins who never install apps? Skylight. They email photos to the frame's own address.
Two grandmas, two frames? Nixplay's free plan links up to 5 frames.
Before you wrap it, load 20 or 30 photos, so it is not an empty screen on day one.
scenes.visual: product:a photo frame filled with family photos

scenes.narration: This time a new photo arrives while she is still unwrapping. She stops dusting it. The full comparison is at the link.
scenes.visual: b-roll:a grandparent smiling at a frame as a new photo appears
